ticket.title: Mine Gold pairs from real git history: pre-fix and post-fix revisions of the same hunk
ticket.description:
The owners intended source of Gold (stated 2026-10-30): backfill and OSS mining over messy history - commits named fix, fix again, another try carry a genuine failed state and a genuine repair, which is exactly a DPO pair and is more honest than any fixture I could invent.

MEASURED GAP: rabbet has no git-history access at all. `rabbet mine-oss --path <dir>` walks a directory (cold_miner.rs mentions .git only to skip it); there is no rev-range, no git log, no commits_between anywhere in rabbet-core. So the source does not exist yet.

DEPENDENCY, and it reframes an existing ticket: the backfill miner needs exactly the history API planned for GB-131 step 3 - commits_between, merge_base, describe_range, all typed and tested against a real repository. That makes GB-131 steps 2-3 a prerequisite for the Gold corpus rather than pure refactor debt.

SCOPE: for a rev range, find hunks that changed and whose commit message matches the repair vocabulary (fix, retry, try again, another attempt, correct); emit (pre-image, post-image) as a Gold candidate with the commit sha as provenance; verify the post-image compiles before it enters the corpus, because a historical commit is not a guarantee. Keep the commit message out of the training pair - it is metadata, not supervision.
